data.title: Design, Development and One-Year Support of a Corporate Website and Customer Self-Service Portal
data.issuer: State Life Insurance Corporation of Pakistan
data.summary: State Life Insurance Corporation of Pakistan seeks proposals for the design, development, deployment and one-year support of a modern corporate website and integrated customer self-service portal. The portal must enable policyholders to view policies, download documents, raise service requests, and make online premium payments, including integrations with the existing core policy system via REST APIs and a payment gateway.

criteria.description: Evaluation criterion for technical proposals; part of technical scoring out of 100.

criteria.name: Financial proposal
criteria.description: Financial evaluation component; only bidders scoring 70+ in technical proceed to financial evaluation.

qa_items.question: Understanding of requirements and proposed solution

data.submission_instructions: Proposals shall be submitted in two sealed envelopes marked "Technical" and "Financial", with one original and one copy each, addressed to the Chief Manager (IT), State Life Insurance Corporation, Principal Office, Karachi. Procurement method stated as Single Stage Two Envelope (PPRA Rules 2014).
